verdict.rationale: Rippling's own docs describe HRIS as the unified source of truth for employee data, with automatic access/permission/group updates on role changes or offboarding, dynamic rules for provisioning/deprovisioning, and device/inventory lifecycle automation tied directly to hiring/offboarding flow — directly matching the joiner/mover/leaver-driven directory and app assignment story. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration beyond vendor docs, and more detail on exactly which HRIS fields trigger which downstream directory changes.
